browserSubsetNote: Browser implements 11 gestures (desktopOnly:false). 5 desktopOnly gestures are explicitly out of scope, no silent fallback to a wrong meme.
videoNote: video:true gestures need <video> playback (desktop: VideoLoop preload). Browser is image-only.

gestures.label: Default (poker cat)
gestures.trigger: No hands and no face-only pose, or 600ms fallback after last gesture

gestures.label: Professor (one finger up)
gestures.trigger: Single index extended, tip held away from face

gestures.label: Fist / Punch
gestures.trigger: One hand, all four fingers curled

gestures.label: Shhh
gestures.trigger: Index finger only, tip resting near mouth

gestures.label: Muehehe (fingertips together)
gestures.trigger: Both hands up, index fingers only, tips touching

gestures.label: Kidnap cat (hand covers face)
gestures.trigger: Any hand shape sitting where your face just was

gestures.label: Crash-out cat
gestures.trigger: Both hands up beside face, both clenched fists

gestures.label: Devastated cat
gestures.trigger: Both hands up, above the top of your head

gestures.label: No monies (open palm)
gestures.trigger: One open palm, all fingers extended, away from face

gestures.label: Judgy cat (look down)
gestures.trigger: Look down slightly sideways (pitch, unvalidated threshold)

gestures.label: Laugh and point
gestures.trigger: Mouth wide open WITH a hand visible

gestures.label: Huh?
gestures.trigger: Mouth open AND eyes wide, no hands

gestures.label: Dance cat
gestures.trigger: Two open palms, one near top of screen, one near bottom (experimental)

gestures.label: O II A I (spin)
gestures.trigger: SPIN in your chair (optical flow, experimental)
